project_metadata.project_name: Supervision2 / 1two.one - Team Themes & Care Compliance Modernization
project_metadata.app_type: Dashboard (Internal Reporting & Analytics Dashboard for UK Adult Social Care Providers)
project_metadata.context: UK Adult Social Care (CQC / Care Certificate compliance, supervision audio transcription & AI evidence extraction)
project_metadata.core_objective: Modernize the 'Team Themes' reporting experience from old-fashioned Excel/spreadsheet tables to high-impact, actionable, accessible, and intuitive visual directions without changing existing data models or functionality.
project_metadata.key_stakeholders: Care Home Managers, Clinical Supervision Leads, CQC Compliance Officers

design_archetypes_and_themes.archetype: Modern Healthcare & Clinical Precision combined with Swiss Functional Clarity
design_archetypes_and_themes.vibe: Trustworthy, clean, empathetic, high-density data, zero clutter, accessible

visual_concept_directions.title: Interactive Heatmap & Slide-Over Audit Inspector
visual_concept_directions.target_feeling: High-tech compliance matrix with instant clarity and zero spreadsheet clutter

evidence_matrix_redesign.layout_approach: Color-coded Heatmap with variable opacity status pills, sticky multi-tier standard category headers, and side-by-side summary bar
evidence_matrix_redesign.cell_visualization: Instead of raw checkmarks or monochrome icons, cells feature rounded soft status capsules with hover tooltips showing exact evidence snippet preview. Clicking a cell slides open a right-side Audit Drawer showing supervision transcript timestamps, audio playback snippet, and CQC evidence clause details.
evidence_matrix_redesign.header_solution: Replace vertical rotated text headers with clean 45-degree angled standard headers or horizontal category group chips (e.g. 'CQC Standard 1: Person-Centred Care') with expandable columns and searchable standard tags.
evidence_matrix_redesign.summary_row: Floating bottom summary bar with dynamic coverage gauges, showing real-time 'Overall Team Readiness %' and one-click 'Highlight Gaps Only' toggle.

ai_accuracy_redesign.table_transformation: Transform standard static table into an interactive decision stream. Upper section features 4 metric gauge widgets (Overall AI Confidence %, High Confidence %, Needs Review Count, Override Rate) and a 'Missed Standards Alert Radar'.
ai_accuracy_redesign.row_treatment: Rows are styled as modern list items with AI Confidence Progress Bars (Green >=90%, Amber 70-89%, Violet <70%), inline snippet audio player, and quick 1-click 'Approve / Reject AI Suggestion' action buttons.

visual_concept_directions.title: Staff-Centric Care Cards & Radial Standard Rings
visual_concept_directions.target_feeling: Focuses on human supervision outcomes and staff mastery rather than cold grid numbers

evidence_matrix_redesign.layout_approach: Dual-View Toggle: Grid View vs Staff Roster Card Grid
evidence_matrix_redesign.cell_visualization: Each staff member is represented as a high-density profile card featuring a radial SVG progress ring (e.g., '84% CQC Evidenced'), pill badges for top achievements, and a mini horizontal matrix barcode for compliance standards.
evidence_matrix_redesign.split_view_mode: Selecting a staff member turns the page into a 35% roster list / 65% deep evidence breakdown showing timeline of supervisions, evidence quotes, and target learning needs.
evidence_matrix_redesign.header_solution: Filters by Care Role (e.g., Senior Carer, Night Nurse, Support Worker) and Standard Category with quick search bar.

ai_accuracy_redesign.table_transformation: Presents AI decisions as an interactive audit queue (Inbox style). Left column displays list of pending decisions sorted by confidence score; right column displays full supervision context with AI highlighted transcript text and manager approval form.

visual_concept_directions.title: Modular Swiss Bento Grid & Command Matrix
visual_concept_directions.target_feeling: Ultra-efficient dashboard designed for quick scanning across large care teams

evidence_matrix_redesign.layout_approach: Bento Grid Dashboard with Compact Micro-Matrix
evidence_matrix_redesign.cell_visualization: Dense 40px grid matrix with toggleable view modes: Symbol View (Icon indicators), Numerical Coverage %, or Micro-Sparklines showing coverage progression over the last 3 supervision cycles.
evidence_matrix_redesign.sticky_ribbon: Sticky top command toolbar with org-scoping dropdowns, date picker, preset filter chips ('Gaps Only', 'High Risk', 'Recently Updated'), and bulk CSV/PDF export actions.

ai_accuracy_redesign.table_transformation: Combines a dynamic decision matrix with a interactive histogram chart showing AI Confidence distribution, top missed standards breakdown, and batch decision toolbar.

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for tabular data, percentages, cell counts)

export_and_filtering_ux.filter_bar: Sticky filter bar with Organization scope, Team selector, Date Range picker, and Quick Search
export_and_filtering_ux.export_modal: Export CSV / PDF dropdown with option to export filtered view or full raw dataset, including evidence quote appendix
export_and_filtering_ux.contextual_actions: Appears when user selects rows/cells to perform bulk operations (e.g. Export Selected, Flag for Review)
